web.line: I'm standing on a ledge and your fine spider web
stanza: Your letters they all say that you're beside me now
Then why do I feel alone?
I'm standing on a ledge and your fine spider web
Is fastening my ankle to a stone

web.line: I do not struggle in your web
stanza: I lie in an early bed thinking late thoughts
Waiting for the black to replace my blue
I do not struggle in your web
Because it was my aim to get caught
Of waiting to be consumed by you
